visual_identity.core_identity: A small lean reptilian humanoid built for traps, pack tactics, and underground survival rather than brute strength.
visual_identity.silhouette: Short wiry reptilian body, long balancing tail, narrow shoulders, slightly hunched alert posture, clawed hands and long clawed feet.
visual_identity.head_features: Long narrow draconic snout, small sharp teeth, pronounced brow, swept horn nubs or short head spines, alert predatory eyes.
visual_identity.body_shape: Lean torso and limbs with clear reptilian anatomy and light digitigrade-looking legs.
visual_identity.surface: Sparse simplified scales with large open coloring regions.

accuracy_checks: horns or head spines are visible
body reads reptilian rather than furry

known_failure_modes.correction: restore long narrow draconic snout, reptilian brow, horn nubs, and visible tail
reduce size and mass; restore small wiry trap-maker proportions

known_failure_modes.symptom: dense scale texture hurts coloring space
known_failure_modes.correction: keep scales sparse and use broad open body regions
